items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: that's not what Luke's hero says, and he used to sell ice cream there.

ctx.x: Well, I could say this, that I can remember walking around in that area, but of course you must remember that it closed 1918. That's correct. According to what we know or what we read about.
Well, that's what they read, but that's not what Luke's hero says, and he used to sell ice cream there.
It was still going. So he ought to know. It was still going on that, wasn't it?
